items.explanation: パ is 'pa': ハ ('ha') with handakuten. It is the same sound as hiragana ぱ. The small circle ゜ is called handakuten. It is only used on the H row and turns h into p.
items.mnemonic: ハ blowing a little bubble ゜: the soft 'h' pops into a 'p', 'pa'.

items.explanation: ピ is 'pi': ヒ ('hi') with handakuten. It is the same sound as hiragana ぴ.
items.mnemonic: ヒ blowing a little bubble ゜: the soft 'h' pops into a 'p', 'pi'.

items.explanation: プ is 'pu': フ ('fu') with handakuten. It is the same sound as hiragana ぷ.
items.mnemonic: フ blowing a little bubble ゜: the soft 'h' pops into a 'p', 'pu'.
items.culture_note: プール means a swimming pool, not the game of pool.

items.explanation: ペ is 'pe': ヘ ('he') with handakuten. It is the same sound as hiragana ぺ.
items.mnemonic: ヘ blowing a little bubble ゜: the soft 'h' pops into a 'p', 'pe'.

items.explanation: ポ is 'po': ホ ('ho') with handakuten. It is the same sound as hiragana ぽ.
items.mnemonic: ホ blowing a little bubble ゜: the soft 'h' pops into a 'p', 'po'.
items.culture_note: ポスト means a postbox; the red postboxes are a familiar sight on Japanese streets.
